import React from 'react';
import { Component, Behavior, createBehavior, createComponent, observable, action, computed, ServiceProvider, type ServiceResolver, createServiceToken } from 'mobx-mantle';
import { container } from 'tsyringe';

export class Preferences { label = 'reports'; }
export const resolve: ServiceResolver = token => container.resolve(token);
export const Named = createServiceToken<{ label: string }>('Named');
// Both token forms must compile against tsyringe's actual InjectionToken type.
export const classService = container.resolve(Preferences);
export const interfaceResolver = () => container.resolve(Named);

export class Base extends Component<{ suffix: string }> {
  readonly preferences = this.inject(Preferences);
  @observable count = 1;
  @computed get title() { return `${this.preferences.label}:${this.count}:${this.props.suffix}`; }
  @action increment() { this.count++; }
}
export class Model extends Base {
  @observable.ref record = { id: 1 };
  @observable.shallow rows = [{ id: 1 }];
  @observable.deep details = { nested: { id: 1 } };
  @observable.struct point = { x: 1 };
  @action override increment() { this.count += 2; }
}
export class Sibling extends Base { @observable sibling = 3; }
export class FlagBase extends Behavior { @observable enabled = false; }
export class Flag extends FlagBase {
  readonly preferences = this.inject(Preferences);
  @computed get label() { return this.enabled ? this.preferences.label : 'off'; }
  @action toggle() { this.enabled = !this.enabled; }
}
export const withFlag = createBehavior(Flag);
export const View = createComponent(Model, model => <button onClick={model.increment}>{model.title}</button>);
export const Host = () => <ServiceProvider resolve={resolve}><View suffix="host" /></ServiceProvider>;
